guards.issue: C#'s SetToFreeThisTurn is `EnergyCost.SetThisTurnOrUntilPlayed(0)` plus SetStarCostThisTurn(0) (CardModel.cs:1266-1270). The sim's set_free_this_turn sets `_free_this_turn = True` (sts2_rl/cards/base.py:260-263) and clears it only in reset_turn_cost_modifiers at the next turn start (sts2_rl/cards/base.py:265-269) -- i.e. 'this turn', with no 'until played' half. So a card that is played and then RETURNS TO HAND in the same turn is free again in the sim and back to full price in the game. EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b17.py puzzlebox): the added card arrives at energy_cost 0 and the hooked cost is 0, so the free-ness itself is right. DORMANT: making it live needs a ported effect that returns a just-played card to HAND within the same turn -- the sim's ported return effects put cards on top of the DRAW pile (NostalgiaPower, powers.py:3586-3602 modify_card_play_result_pile), which set_free_this_turn's window does not reach because the card cannot be replayed from there this turn without a second effect. Porting any 'return the played card to your hand' card makes it live. The star-cost half is the same out-of-scope currency audit/records/relic/brilliant_scarf.json waives on TryModifyStarCost. Rule 7: CardModel.cs, sts2_rl/cards/base.py, powers.py and audit/records/relic/brilliant_scarf.json are NOT hashed by this record.
